title: Apollo astronauts given suicide pills
summary: James Fox tells of Apollo astronauts given suicide pills, about 1969 at The Moon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: she said that the NASA authorities said that they were all given some kind of pill that they would die if anything happened.

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox, on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on what a woman named Fay Ann Potter told him about the 1969 Moon missions run by NASA, the US space agency. According to her, NASA officials said the astronauts were each given a pill that would kill them if anything went wrong. He tells it as a sign of how much was kept hidden about those missions.
